cause_quote: The introducing diff added `readHistoricalHistoryAnchorPage(projection, history.displaySource, options)` only to the canonical anchor reader, which the Claude CLI import path bypassed.
user_saw: After the first Claude CLI turn following a reset, opening history around an older message returned an empty page.
summary: The fix routes pre-reset anchors outside the CLI index to the canonical reader and preserves that reader's cursor source and message sequence.
reasoning: The September change introduced reopening closed reset intervals within the same transcript through the canonical anchor reader. I checked the gateway at that commit and confirmed that requests with an active Claude CLI import used a merge limited to the latest reset window and returned an empty page when the anchor was absent. The October indexing rewrite preserved that failure through its index-only lookup.
